text:
Riya (Design): Quick review request - banner copy for expired API keys. UX copy in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc. Need something short, calm, and clear. PTAL.
Dan (Product): goal: make it obvious why requests fail and give one obvious next step. keep it < 80 chars ideally.
Riya (Design): current draft: 'Your API key expired. Create a new key to resume requests.'
Lena (Accessibility): nice and direct. small a11y bits: ensure banner is announced via aria-live=polite and the CTA is keyboard focusable. also avoid passive voice if we can.
Cory (Frontend): implementation constraints: banner component supports primary + tertiary links, not secondary. primary should be short (2-3 words). We render HTML in banner body so linking is fine.
Dan (Product): alt copy: 'API key expired. Rotate your key to continue.' shorter, but 'rotate' might be unclear to new users.
Riya (Design): what about: body: 'Your API key expired for security. Create a new key to resume requests.' CTA: 'Create API key' tertiary: 'Learn more'
Lena (Accessibility): prefer 'was revoked' vs 'expired' if action triggered it, but we don't know. Use neutral: 'is no longer valid'. Eg: 'Your API key is no longer valid. Create a new key to resume requests.'
Cory (Frontend): note: we also show an error toast in SDK logs with code 401. Make sure banner copy uses 'resume' not 'retry' to avoid confusion. SDK teams asked that text include 'resume requests' so logs map to UI.
Riya (Design): updated proposal: Title: 'API key not valid' Body: 'Your API key is no longer valid. Create a new key to resume requests.' CTA: 'Create API key' Tertiary: 'Why did this happen?' -> links to docs.
Dan (Product): title looks odd. Users scan for 'API key' but 'not valid' feels slightly abrupt. Could be 'API key expired or revoked' but too long. Maybe: 'API key inactive' ?
Lena (Accessibility): 'inactive' is ambiguous. For screen reader clarity, keep the title precise: 'API key not valid' is machine-readable and spoken clearly. Also request adding visually hidden prefix for SRs: 'Alert:' so screen readers announce priority.
Cory (Frontend): actionable item: Use <div role="status" aria-live="polite"> and button <button aria-label="Create API key and return to keys page">Create API key</button>. We'll track click with analytics event banner_api_create.
Riya (Design): ok final copy to lock for dev: Title = 'API key not valid' Body = 'Your API key is no longer valid. Create a new key to resume requests.' Primary CTA = 'Create API key' Tertiary = 'Why did this happen?' (links to docs).
Dan (Product): +1. Add small helper text under CTA for org admins: 'Only org admins can create keys.' maybe show conditionally.
Lena (Accessibility): confirm color contrast for banner text >= 4.5:1, CTA meets 3:1 for large text or 4.5:1 for small. Also keyboard focus order: CTA should be first focusable element.
Cory (Frontend): noted. I'll implement and add feature flag 'banner-api-key-reauth'. Will also add an automated e2e asserting aria-live announcement and CTA focus behavior.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled to staging at 2025-07-12T09:00:00Z
Riya (Design): thanks team. I'll update figma and the copy doc and drop updated strings into the i18n spreadsheet. Ping me for localization notes. :white_check_mark:
Dan (Product): logging ticket -> #2248 to add SDK mapping and docs link.
Riya (Design): creating follow-up to add admin hint in admin-only state.
